evidence: The depositions were carried out using MoCl4O (Sigma-Aldrich, 97%) as the Mo source and distilled H2O and O3 pulsed simultaneously as the O source. O3 was supplied from an In USA ozone generator (AC-2505) at 15 wt. % O3 in O2, using O2 from a gas cylinder (Praxair, 99.5%). Both MoCl4O and H2O were kept at room temperature in external containers, and MoCl4O was assisted by N2 carrier gas.
